# proxmox_cluster_join (Resource)

Joins this node to an existing cluster through `POST /cluster/config/join` and waits for the task. The action is imperative: every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op. `fingerprint` must be the SHA-256 fingerprint of the peer node certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_join" "cluster" {
  hostname    = "10.0.0.2"
  password    = var.peer_root_password
  fingerprint = var.peer_certificate_fingerprint
  triggers    = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 certificate fingerprint of the peer node.
- `hostname` (String) IP or DNS name of an existing cluster node.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) `root@pam` password of the peer node.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to join again.

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) Force the join even if the peer reports warnings.
- `links` (Set of String)
- `node_id` (Number) Explicit node id in the cluster.
- `votes` (Number) Corosync votes for this node.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Join identifier (the peer hostname).
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
